job.title: Manager Digital Growth & Automation (gn) Vollzeit/Teilzeit (hybrid)
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

You need someone who connects systems, data and AI to grow digital channels – I have built and automated digital commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell for 5+ years.

– Used generative AI / LLM tools extensively across analysis, development, testing and documentation
– Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub
– Analysed requirements with business stakeholders, wrote user stories and functional specifications, supported UAT

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Would you have 15 minutes for a short call in the coming days? My CV and cover letter are attached.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Digital Platforms & Automation | AI-Assisted Delivery, Integrations & Analysis
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional digital professional with 5+ years on enterprise digital commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Automates and optimizes processes through data pipelines, scheduled jobs (Cronjobs), API integrations and Groovy scripts, and uses generative AI / LLM tools and prompt engineering extensively across analysis, development and documentation. Analyses business requirements with stakeholders, maps processes and turns them into working digital solutions. Strong in SQL, REST APIs and PIM/ERP/MDM integration; agile and international.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: DKV Mobility is one of Europe's leading B2B platforms for on-the-road payments and is digitalising mobility for thousands of fleet customers. Growth through automation is exactly where my techno-functional experience fits: digital platforms, integrations, data pipelines and daily AI-assisted work for Rockwell Automation and Shell.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, your Manager Digital Growth & Automation role at DKV Mobility interests me: 5+ years automating digital commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell – data pipelines, APIs, generative AI tools, requirements. Start 16.12.2026. Open to a short call?

en.subject: Application: Manager Digital Growth & Automation
en.hook: Growing a digital business through automation means connecting systems, data and processes so customers get a smooth experience at scale. That has been my work for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I build and automate digital commerce platforms – and I use generative AI tools every day to deliver faster.

bullets.label: Automation
bullets.text: Built PIM-to-shop data pipelines, scheduled Cronjobs and Groovy administrative scripts that keep catalogs synchronized across global channels.

bullets.label: AI in daily work
bullets.text: Used generative AI / LLM tools extensively to accelerate analysis, development, testing and documentation – with prompt engineering and critical review of the output through code reviews.

bullets.label: Process & requirements
bullets.text: In a techno-functional role, analysed requirements with business stakeholders, wrote user stories and functional specifications and translated them into SAP Commerce solutions; at Shell, mapped processes and supported UAT.

bullets.label: Digital growth levers
bullets.text: Developed the Promotions Engine and headless APIs for storefronts; led database query refactoring that reduced response latency.

en.logistics: I combine technical depth with a business view, which helps turn automation ideas into results. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would welcome a conversation about your digital growth roadmap.
